info.name: Internship Registration API
info.description:
Run the folders in order (0 -> 12). Fill adminEmail, adminPassword and studentEmail in the collection variables first. Tokens and ids are saved automatically by each request's Tests script.

Payment: Postman cannot open Razorpay Checkout. Folder 6 only checks create-order; pay in payment-test.html with the same student login, then continue with folder 7.

variable.description: FILL: email of a SUPER_ADMIN account
FILL: a real inbox you can open (the OTP is emailed). Use a new one per test run.
FILL after 'Send OTP': the 6-digit code from the email
FILL after 'Forgot password': the code from the email
FILL for simulated payment: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET from .env (TEST key only; keep local)

request.description: No browser needed. The pre-request script signs a fake payment id with your TEST key secret, exactly as Razorpay would, and calls verify. The registration becomes ENROLLED and the success email is sent. The payment will NOT appear in the Razorpay Dashboard. Never use a live key secret here.
